name: Mire Deep Pit
body:
School conjuration (creation) [earth, water]; Level sorcerer/wizard 4, summoner 4, unchained summoner .

Effect 10-ft.-by-10-ft. hole, 10 ft. deep/2 level.

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as mire deep except the area is smaller and the target falls down a pit first as per the spell create pit, the maximum depth of the pit is 100 feet, then the quicksand extends for 20 feet past the bottom of the pit.
